text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins, and Mejiro
McQueen's
heart leaps at the prospect
of training surrounded
by nature.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She looks toward the Kikuka Sho and its
prelude,
the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm and motivation bubble
up inside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
